To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the 3D simulator Gazebo is a useful tool for testing and optimizing the navigation and application algorithms of autonomous service robots for vinicultures and horticulture.
the developed 3D simulation framework allows the virtual testing and optimization of the robot platform and its navigation as well as application processes prior to its real world application.
The developed simulation environment allows to simulate the robot in a realistic 3D environment and thus to test the robot platform, the sensors and algorithms in a virtual world.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a multi sensor based navigation environment for an autonomous service robot for vineyards and orchard.
autonomous service robots for vinicultures and fruit orchards.
autonomous service robots for vineyards and orchard applications, in particular with the development of a 3D environment for navigation and applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the 3D environment of the multi sensor based navigation is an important tool for the development of autonomous service robots.
the simulation environment is an essential component of an autonomous robot application.
a virtual test and simulation environment is a valuable tool to develop autonomous field robots.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the simulation environment has proven itself in the development of the autonomous service robot and its applications.
the simulation environment has been developed for the application of autonomous vehicles in orchards and vineyards.
a 3D environment for autonomous vehicle navigation and application in orchards and vineyards has been developed.
The main takeaway from our work is that

ROS is a very good framework to integrate different sensors (e.g. camera, laser range finder) with different software algorithms (e.g. image based localization, obstacle avoidance, application) for navigation and applications.
a 3D simulator is a powerful tool for the development of a robot platform for autonomous navigation and application processes in orchards and vineyards.
the 3D environment allows the virtual test and optimization of the robot platform as well as the software for navigation and application.
